description: Saves a dapps.theta listing draft for a person to finish in Wave's dApps creator: info, one of the 12 design recipes, optional settings and files (≤50, ≤1 MB, stored privately, never run). Returns draft_id, checks and a one-time continue_url (7 days). Draft only. Needs sign-in (auth_challenge then auth_verify).

draft.description: name (≤40), pitch (≤140), label?, category, tags (≤6), url (https), contracts, source, support, description, onchain, screenshots (≤3), design (template id e.g. "wave-teal", or { template, headline, subline }), settings { embed }, files [{ path, text | content_base64 }]

name: dapp_draft_save
title: Save a dApp draft
